short: Gathers valuable information in one place before stealing it.
analogy: Puts everything valuable into one bag.

solutionNotes.dlp: Knows where valuable data lives and notices when it’s being gathered in bulk.
solutionNotes.edr: Spots programs that capture the screen, read the clipboard or pack archives.
solutionNotes.ueba: Notices when a person suddenly downloads far more than usual.
solutionNotes.email: Spots mail forwarding rules that send messages outside.
